purpose: Keep the bounded Queue V2 implementation slice distinct from the larger product vision and resolve symbolic queue sources to durable repository documents.
assistant_os_invariants: UAA is a local-first assistant operating layer joining intent, information, plans, approvals, actions, memory, and evidence.
The Python Agent Core owns product truth and authority; Control Center and other shells do not mint authority.
Govern access, memory, tools, state, and side effects without degrading ordinary informational assistance.
A completed queue slice does not mean the whole product vision is complete.
Planning and recovered historical intent grant no runtime, provider, connector, browser, shell, publication, or production authority.

coverage_policy.expansion_rule: queue_item_dispositions must classify every Queue V2 item. Add a registry entry whenever that disposition is required.
coverage_policy.completion_rule: whole_vision.status may be complete only when whole_vision.completion_evidence_refs is non-empty and independently verified.

items.title: First-class CRM

current_slice.name: ECO-005 private local CRM foundation
current_slice.outcome: Establish canonical private CRM identity, relationships, opportunities, activities, projections, and governed handoffs on shared local data.

whole_vision.outcome: A relationship-centered operator system spanning personal and business contacts, pipeline, communications, follow-up, Today, Calendar, Work Board, Evidence, and later exact read-only or approval-bound adapters.

items.recovery_note: No recovery required; the detailed implementation plan preserves the whole vision and staged authority boundaries.

items.title: News and Signals

current_slice.name: deterministic local signal records and Morning Briefing candidacy
current_slice.outcome: Provide a readable, provenance-preserving local review lane without live source authority.

whole_vision.outcome: A personalized situational-intelligence desk that curates authorized RSS, official updates, community sources, and later exact adapters into News, Morning Briefing, and optional reviewed action proposals.

items.recovery_note: Archive review confirmed the existing module plan retains the source-to-News-to-Briefing-to-proposal loop.

items.title: Social Media Intelligence

current_slice.name: read-only social intelligence product contract
current_slice.outcome: Define an operator-readable Observe, Plan, Engage, Create, Learn loop without publishing authority.

whole_vision.outcome: A creator-focused hub for engagement quality, audience growth, cadence, relationships, response opportunities, content learning, and evidence-backed recommendations across configured channels.

items.recovery_note: No thin-plan repair required; archive review adds confidence that the existing product contract preserves the intended creator loop.

items.title: Finance and Compliance local product

current_slice.name: local review and accountant handoff foundation
current_slice.outcome: Organize local financial evidence, exceptions, questions, review decisions, and reversible ChangeSets without financial authority.

whole_vision.outcome: A local-first finance and compliance workspace that explains evidence, exceptions, books, obligations, and decisions while routing unresolved treatment to a qualified reviewer.

items.recovery_note: No recovery required; the product, implementation, and threat-model set preserves detailed intent.

items.title: Proposal Intelligence

current_slice.name: deterministic cited workflow candidates
current_slice.outcome: Create cited, reviewable event, task, person, commitment, CRM-link, and meeting candidates with deterministic extraction before any model-assisted candidate generation.

whole_vision.outcome: A private proposal-intelligence layer that turns source-backed communications and meetings into explainable candidate records, preserves uncertainty and citations, and promotes only reviewed candidates into canonical workflows.

items.recovery_note: The durable ECO-010 contract remains authoritative: proposal intelligence means cited workflow and meeting candidates, not capability-graph product discovery.

items.title: Autocorrect controls

current_slice.name: proposal-only correction controls
current_slice.outcome: Produce exact, reviewable, revision-bound ChangeSet corrections with stale blocking, rejection capture, receipts, and rollback.

whole_vision.outcome: A cross-UAA correction layer that catches likely mistakes, explains why, learns from reviewed accept or reject decisions, and improves future proposals without silently rewriting canonical truth.

items.recovery_note: No exact archived prompt was located. The plan is a conservative reconstruction from Queue V2, the recovery contract, ChangeSet semantics, and the assistant-utility invariant.

items.title: Governed self-improvement

current_slice.name: self-assessment and improvement proposal loop
current_slice.outcome: Turn redacted failures, friction, eval gaps, and feedback into evidence-backed proposals routed through Action Inbox.

whole_vision.outcome: UAA autonomously recognizes how it should improve, proposes bugs, workflows, skills, integrations, docs, or configuration changes, and—only after exact human decisions—carries accepted changes through scoped implementation, tests, review, PR evidence, and outcome learning.

items.recovery_note: The original repository prompt did not survive, but the archived design conversation preserved the end-to-end loop, phase boundaries, and authority model at high confidence.

items.title: Cross-platform social publishing

current_slice.name: multi-platform proposal and dry-run
current_slice.outcome: Create canonical drafts, platform variants, compatibility findings, exact approvals, and per-target dry-run receipts without connecting accounts or publishing.

whole_vision.outcome: Create once, visibly adapt per platform, approve an exact bundle, publish through independently graduated adapters, preserve independent outcomes, retry only failed targets, reconcile uncertainty, and learn from returned engagement.
future_stages: one exact adapter at a time

items.recovery_note: Archive review recovered the creator workflow, typed nouns, per-platform approval model, partial-failure semantics, and later adapter sequence.

items.title: Final GoatCitadel comparison

current_slice.name: exact-revision skepticism-first comparison
current_slice.outcome: Score demonstrated system-level agent capability across exact revisions, directly observe comparable chat and operator workflows, and route residual gaps or transferable patterns without importing competitor code or inflating parity.

whole_vision.outcome: A repeatable closing benchmark that tells whether UAA's reasoning, planning, memory, learning, tools, authority, evidence, UX, parity, extensibility, and complete operator loop are stronger, weaker, or intentionally different from GoatCitadel.

items.recovery_note: Archive review recovered the original 16-component taxonomy, scoring scale, evidence hierarchy, output structure, and anti-inflation rules.
